results.overview: With help from a 102-year-old goblin dwelling beneath their haunted apartment building, two siblings deal with ghosts and take on spooky mysteries.
results.name: The Haunted House

results.overview: There are Metal Cardbots on Earth that are living by transforming them into vehicles, hiding stagnation. The protagonist Jun accidentally gets the Metal Breath in his hands, and gets caught up in numerous events with Blue Cop... Can Jun seal the Metal Cardbots scattered on Earth?
results.name: Metal Cardbot

results.overview: Set in the "Train World" where all citizens are trains. However, among the residents there are special trains that can transform into robots, the Robot Trains! Featuring our 5 train heroes, with special powers: Kay, Alf, Duck, Selly and Victor - and their exciting adventures. Can the Robot Trains save the village from the evil dark forces that be?
results.name: Robot Trains

results.overview: There are many different kinds of life form living on planets in the univers. Among them, dinosaurs that are now extict on Earth lives on the planet called M25. The dino-explorers are dispatched in order to let the children of Earth know about the diversity and the beauty of life. The dino-ecplorers are a team of explorers consisting of Dr.Beard, a dinosaur expert who has dedicated his whole life on researching the extinct dinosaurs, and transformable robot dinosaurs. They discover dinosaurs through exploration and help them, and befriend them.
results.name: GoGo Dino

results.overview: Join 4 extraordinary kids as they travel to an alternate Earth where dinosaurs never went extinct, using hi-tech suits and transforming vehicles to protect the dinos from an inter-dimensional villain intent on taking over the multiverse.
results.name: Quantum Heroes Dinoster

results.overview: Wanting to bring home the ultimate prize, a group of competitors gather for a championship — and discover both friends and enemies as they play!
results.name: Running Man

results.overview: Grade-schooler Jason meets a Mecanimal, a transforming minicar from the alternate world of Triforce, named Evan. Jason and Evan are both searching for missing family members, and team up to help each other. Together, they meet more Mecanimals as they battle across dimensions and learn important lessons along the way.
results.name: Turning Mecard

results.overview: After a strange and devastating attack on his home, a young boy named Rai is shocked to discover he’s a secret descendent of the Tigeroids: an ancient race of peaceful beings locked in a struggle with the ruthless and cunning Dragonoids. In a parallel universe called Suhn, the Tigeroids and Dragonoids are battling furiously to recover 500 lost tai chi characters. Whoever retrieves these precious and potent symbols will possess the ultimate power to rule their realm... and destroy their enemies. As Rai hones his innate tai chi skills to fight the Dragonoids, he must find the lost tai chi and battle to become one of the champion Tai Chi Chasers!
results.name: Tai Chi Chasers

results.overview: A dangerously sweet romance entangled by a perilous contract between Kim Euihyun, a man pushed to the edge, and Yeo Taeju, a sly and calculating loan shark. Having given up on everything and prepared to end his life alongside his younger sibling, Euihyun is stopped by Taeju. In exchange for a home and a job, he becomes bound to a deal that demands his body, stepping into a relationship he cannot escape. Thus begins their tenacious entanglement. Euihyun is swept up in Taeju’s whims and his unreadable acts of kindness, while Euihyun’s unyielding nature only fuels Taeju’s growing fascination. What starts as an unpredictable connection spirals into a tangled web of obsession and anxiety, pity and desire—drawing them into a bond neither can break free from.
results.name: Low Tide in Twilight The Animation

results.overview: Jin and his dragon monster Draka set out on a racing adventure and try to save the kingdom from evil forces.
results.name: Monkart

results.overview: Rainbow Bubblegem recounts the magical adventures of seven mermaid princesses who must go to school on land to search for enchanted jewels to save their undersea realm from an evil witch.
results.name: Rainbow Bubblegem

results.original_name: ギャラクシーレーサースキャン2ゴー
results.overview:
Sometime in the near future, in an age in which we have established contact and communications with planets outside our galaxy, Scan2Go has become a huge phenomenon throughout all of outer space. Giant races are held at every locality, with each racer gunning for the title of the universe's number one racer!

The main character in the series, Kazuya, possesses the power of the eagle, performed well with his blazing, innate power commanding his falconine beast spirit. He competes in a tournament, the "Pro-Racer Exhibition Race.", but was no match for the other teams that had won their way through the competitive Space Preliminaries.

Realizing the difficult obstacles that lie before them, Kazuya and his friends leave the small Earth behind and set off on a universe-wide quest to hone their skills as warriors!
results.name: Scan2Go

results.overview: Basketball, Baseball, Soccer… When it comes to handling a ball, Cha Youngwoong, a fifth-grade elementary school student, exhibits overwhelming abilities. One day, while cleaning out the warehouse at the request of his mother, he discovers a mysterious marble. At that moment, the villain duo "Team MABORI" and the monster creature 'Pachyla' appear to break the warehouse and threaten the hero, but With the help of the Mechanimal 'Akan' hidden in the warehouse, he uses a mysterious orb - 'Mecard Ball' to succeed in defeating them.
results.name: Mecard Ball

results.overview: The animated antics of twins who use teamwork and problem-solving skills to keep a clock ticking.
results.name: Tickety Toc

results.overview: In a society that favors good looks, a high school outcast leads a double life switching between his two bodies that are polar opposites in appearance.
results.name: Lookism

results.overview: When their animal friends need help, brother-and-sister team Toby and Teri use the clues and follow the facts to solve mysteries in their own backyard.
results.name: Treehouse Detectives

results.overview: Stranded on a tropical island, two silly larva buddies find slapstick fun in everything from discovering food to meeting new animal friends.
results.name: Larva Island

results.overview: Play with curious, warm-hearted Bada and his adventurous animal buddies as they learn something new every day in this educational series.
results.name: Badanamu Stories
